name: Great Maha
description: A giant bird whose wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn and which expressed anger when its egg was stolen.

description_citations.text: Bloomburrow: card flavor text (Bloomburrow, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glarb orders the Great Maha's egg stolen, and the Great Maha communicates its anger.
timeline.quote: When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

citation.text: Fell (Bloomburrow, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
